findings.title: D20-to-D08 repaired-head replay conflicts in ArtifactStore
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 8: replay of the same checkpoint/head must be idempotent; this also blocks Criteria 7 and 11.
findings.trigger: D20 physically admits a repaired domain child, then D21 routes the required D08 revalidation, which emits the same logical head.
findings.consequence: The persistence bridge generates a different idempotency key for D08 and calls admit_version before checking the existing equal head. ArtifactStore raises ArtifactConflict, which the graph boundary converts to SYSTEM_FAILURE, preventing the repaired N70 path from continuing.
findings.evidence: rc13_cross_node_replay_repro.py produced `D20 physical admission: PASS`, followed by `ArtifactConflict: version 1 of units/U001/domain already exists`. runtime/langgraph_factory/graph.py:330-344 includes node_id in the key and checks current_head only after admit_version; artifacts.py:388-393 rejects the existing version.

findings.title: D09 crashes whenever it revalidates an admitted content head
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 7 requires a valid repaired content first child to be admitted as genesis and revalidated.
findings.trigger: A repaired content child is the current logical head when D21 dispatches D09_VALIDATE_CONTENT.
findings.consequence: D09 raises NameError before performing any content checks, so every repaired-content retest terminates as a system failure.
findings.evidence: rc13_content_revalidation_repro.py reached D09 with the D20 child as current head and raised `NameError: name 'current_head' is not defined`. runtime/langgraph_factory/nodes/content.py:131-134 references undefined `current_head`; the actual variable is `content_head` at line 116.

findings.title: D20 drops lineage required to revalidate repaired content
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 7 requires repaired content to retain lineage and revalidate successfully.
findings.trigger: D20 admits either a first or later content repair.
findings.consequence: The child omits schema_path and domain_hash, both required by D09. Even after correcting RC13-QA-002, D09 would reject the child for a missing schema and stale/missing domain lineage.
findings.evidence: rc13_content_revalidation_repro.py executed D20 and printed `D20 child has schema_path: False` and `D20 child has domain_hash: False`. repair.py:1069-1089 copies validation metadata only for the domain channel, while content.py:151-164 requires schema_path and content.py:197-211 requires domain_hash.

findings.title: Visual retest replaces the repaired head with stale pre-repair data
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 7 requires a valid repaired visual first child to remain the admitted genesis and be revalidated.
findings.trigger: D20 repairs a reviewer-identified visual defect, after which D21 routes the visual retest through D10 and D12 while the original visual_results remain in state.
findings.consequence: D12 does not revalidate the repaired current head. It reconstructs a new successor from the old visual_results and admits the pre-repair content again, undoing the repair and allowing the same defect to recur.
findings.evidence: rc13_visual_revalidation_repro.py supplied a repaired v1 with `Corrected accessible description`; D12 returned `visuals_admitted`, version 2 parented to that repaired head, but its body contained `Original defective description`. repair.py:119-145 routes visual retests through D10; visuals.py:444-470 always rebuilds the body from visual_results and lines 543-548 advances that newly reconstructed candidate.

findings.title: D02 accepts an incomplete domain contract
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 4 explicitly requires D02 to reject incomplete proof while freezing all curriculum-owned domain inputs.
findings.trigger: The active manifest omits required domain members such as config, calibration, or verifier.
findings.consequence: D02 reports successful effective-run compilation with domain_contract null instead of rejecting entry. The run can proceed into capability and source/model work before D07 eventually fails, so the required complete pre-entry freeze is absent.
findings.evidence: rc13_d02_incomplete_contract_repro.py ran the real D02 and produced `guard: effective_run_compiled`, `domain_contract: None`, and `pending_failure present: False`. inputs.py:709-714 deliberately returns None for absent or incomplete declarations rather than failing.

findings.title: D08 validates against drifted artifact-schema bytes
findings.criterion_ref: Criteria 4 and 6 require frozen-input drift rejection and validation against the correct frozen artifact schema.
findings.trigger: The domain artifact schema changes after D02/M02 staging but before D08 validation.
findings.consequence: D08 ignores the frozen schema SHA-256, reads the replacement bytes, and can admit a candidate invalid under the frozen contract, making the admission unverifiable against the effective-run identity.
findings.evidence: rc13_d08_schema_drift_repro.py froze schema SHA `8752b241...`, replaced it with SHA `ff419ebb...`, and D08 still returned `domain_admitted` with `domain_schema_valid: PASS`. domain.py:194-215 resolves and loads schema_path but never compares it with domain_contract.schema.sha256.

observations: The supplied bundle SHA-256 matched exactly.
Graph v8, graph v9, approval schema v6, approval contract v6, and governing-specification digests all recomputed to the claimed values.
The real plan validator passed with N00 through N90 in order. N70, N80, and N90 explicitly bind `.run27_state_v9`, closing the stated RC12 namespace defect.

The exact package suite passed 176 tests and the exact focused suite passed 792 tests, including the real verifier polarity tests. Those suites do not exercise the failing cross-node repair/store integrations above.
reasoning: The package’s static bindings, hashes, state namespaces, validator, and cited suites held up under execution. FAIL is based only on reproduced blocker paths: domain repair fails at physical replay, content repair has two independent revalidation failures, visual retest restores stale bytes, and the domain freeze permits incomplete or drifted schema authority. These defects make a fresh repaired N70/N80 cascade unable to satisfy Criteria 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, and 11 despite the passing suites.
